hotel.title: The Hotel
hotel.subtitle: Modern comfort in the heart of Tel Aviv
hotel.aboutText1: "The O Pod" hotel established in 2021, it is located at the foot of the Mediterranean Sea with breathtaking views from most of the hotel areas and some of the capsules.
hotel.aboutText2: The hotel has a terrace facing the sea, with bar seats and sun beds.
hotel.aboutText3: The capsules are ventilated with an external AC system, including a comfortable and high-quality mattress, a shelf / closet for storage, and a night lamp.
hotel.aboutText4: The showers and toilets are shared and located outside the pods, pods are for sleeping only!
hotel.aboutText5: The hotel is located 1.9 km from Shenkin Street, 2.1 km from Meir Park and 2.4 km from Dizengoff Center.
hotel.aboutText6: Popular points of interest near the capsule hotel include Suzanne Dellal Center for Dance and Theater, Independence Hall Museum and Nachalat Benyamin Crafts Fair. The nearest airport is Ben Gurion Airport, 12 km from The O Pod Hotel.
hotel.receptionDesc: Our reception is always open. Check in any time, get help whenever you need it.
hotel.lockersDesc: Free secure lockers for all guests. Store your valuables and luggage safely.
hotel.showersDesc: Clean, gender-separated shower facilities with hot water 24/7.
hotel.acDesc: All pods are climate-controlled for your comfort year-round.
hotel.wifiDesc: Free fast WiFi throughout the hotel. Work, stream, stay connected.
hotel.areasDesc: Relax in our lounge, meet fellow travelers, enjoy the rooftop terrace.
hotel.accessibilityText1: We are committed to providing accessible accommodation for all guests. Our O Comfy pods are specially designed with accessibility in mind, featuring wider entrances, more maneuvering space, and comfortable headroom.
hotel.accessibilityText2: The hotel has elevator access to all floors, and our staff is trained to assist guests with disabilities. Please contact us before booking if you have specific accessibility requirements.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: (Updated in accordance with Amendment No. 13 to the Privacy Protection Law)
privacy.section1Text: The hotel "TheOpod Hotel" – (we) is committed to protecting the privacy of our guests and website users. This privacy statement explains how we collect, use, store, and process personal information in accordance with the Privacy Protection Law, including Amendment No. 13, and relevant regulations.
privacy.section2Text:
Information is managed by:
Theopod Hotel
Business Number: 513718254
Address: Kaufmann Street 2, Tel Aviv
Contact email for privacy matters: opodhotel@gmail.com
privacy.section3Title: 3. What types of information do we collect
privacy.section3Text:
a. Contact details: Full name, phone, email.
b. Booking and stay details: Dates, room type, accommodation preferences, number of guests.
c. Payment information: Credit card details are processed through a certified payment provider; we do not store complete card information.
d. Browsing and device data: IP address, browser, cookies, usage data for analytics and user experience improvement.
e. Communications with the hotel: Inquiries via phone/email/website forms.
privacy.section4Title: 4. Purposes of information processing and legal basis
privacy.section4Text:
a. Managing bookings, service operation, and providing hospitality experience — processing essential to contract execution.
b. Billing, accounting, and compliance with legal obligations.
c. Information security and fraud prevention — legitimate interest.
d. Sending marketing offers — only with active consent (opt-in).
e. Service improvement, website usage analysis, and technological operation.
privacy.section5Title: 5. Disclosure and transfer of information to third parties
privacy.section5Text:
We may transfer information to the following entities, subject to data protection agreements:
• Secure payment providers (Payment Gateway)
• External booking system/Channel Manager
• Cloud services hosting the website
• Information security and analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics)

Transfer of information outside Israel will be done in accordance with legal requirements and applicable regulations.
privacy.section6Text:
We will retain personal information for the period required for processing purposes or according to law:
• Booking details and invoices — up to 7 years for tax and regulatory purposes.
• Operational and browsing data — according to operational needs, usually for a shorter period.
• Marketing information — until the user requests deletion or ceases use.
privacy.section7Text:
In accordance with Amendment 13, you have the following rights:
• Right of access to information
• Right to correct inaccurate information
• Right to erasure of information (subject to legal obligations)
• Right to object to information processing or limit processing
• Right to file a complaint with the Privacy Protection Authority

Requests can be sent to: opodhotel@gmail.com
privacy.section8Text: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information, including encryption, access controls, and separation of sensitive information. Nevertheless, complete security cannot be guaranteed. In case of a significant security incident, we will act according to legal reporting requirements.
privacy.section9Text: If a data protection officer is appointed according to the scope of processing, contact details will be updated here. Currently, privacy responsibility is managed by the hotel management.
privacy.section10Text:
We will update this document from time to time. Last update date: 10/11/2025
Use of the website constitutes consent to this policy.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By making a reservation, you agree to these terms and conditions.
terms.content: By booking a capsule at The O Pod Hotel, you agree to the present terms and conditions. All reservations must be guaranteed with a valid credit card, with payment required at the time of booking. Check-in is available from 3:00 PM, and check-out must be completed by 11:00 AM. Guests are expected to respect other guests and hotel property. Smoking is prohibited throughout the establishment. Quiet hours are enforced between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM. Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations made within 48 hours of check-in will incur a one-night charge. The hotel is not responsible for the loss or damage to personal belongings. Secure lockers are provided for guest use.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
accessibilityPage.intro: The O Pod Hotel is committed to ensuring accessibility for all guests.
accessibilityPage.section1Text: O Comfy pods feature wider entrances, lower beds, and extra space for mobility devices.
accessibilityPage.section2Text: Elevator access, wheelchair-accessible bathrooms, tactile signage, visual alarms, designated parking.
accessibilityPage.section3Text: 24/7 staff trained to assist. Inform us of special requirements at booking.
accessibilityPage.section4Text: Our website is compatible with screen readers. Report issues to help us improve.
accessibilityPage.section5Text: Service animals welcome. Please inform us in advance.
